question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Numerous**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses multiple health benefits associated with antioxidants.
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate a large quantity to match the context of varied health benefits.
 
• "Numerous" fits well as it means many or a large number, which aligns with the context of the sentence describing multiple health benefits.
 
• Other options ("**Few**", "**Countable**", "**Limited**") do not convey the sense of a large quantity of benefits.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *(1)Numerous__ health benefits, including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer, have been (2)_______ to antioxidants; however, according to dietitian Vinson, these benefits depend on how well antioxidants are absorbed and (3)______ by the body. According to the study, coffee has more antioxidant power than other well-known foods and drinks, like tea, milk, chocolate, and cranberries. Dates had the highest antioxidants per serving out of all the foods and drinks (4)______, but because dates are not consumed to the same extent as coffee, the latter comes out on (5)______, according to Vinson.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Few: Indicates a small number, which does not align with the context of the passage describing a large number of health benefits.
 
• Countable: Refers to something that can be counted, which is not suitable for describing the numerous health benefits.
 
• Limited: Suggests a restricted quantity, which is not appropriate for the context of the passage discussing a wide range of benefits.
